homeContent.hero_heading: Welcome to Saraswati Vidya Mandir Public School
homeContent.hero_subtitle: Let Your Future Bright • A World Class Learning Environment in Semla, Dumka
homeContent.about_intro: Saraswati Vidya Mandir Public School, Semla is an esteemed English Medium institution providing value-based education based on CBSE pattern and curriculum from Nursery to Class X. Nestled in a serene and lush green campus at Kathig, Jones, Semla (Dumka, Jharkhand), our school nurtures intellectual curiosity, moral integrity, physical fitness, and creative spirit.
homeContent.vision: To be an exemplary center of academic excellence and holistic child development where traditional Indian values merge seamlessly with modern scientific education, producing enlightened and compassionate future citizens.
homeContent.mission: To empower every student through experiential learning, personalized teacher mentorship, competitive examination coaching, and comprehensive sports and cultural activities, ensuring that no deserving child is deprived of quality education.
homeContent.history: Founded under Registration No. 2162/07 with the blessings of Maa Saraswati, the school was established to bring top-tier English Medium schooling to the children of Semla and Dumka district. Over the years, SVMPS has grown into a beacon of educational discipline, cultural vibrancy, and academic distinction.
homeContent.philosophy: Rooted in the eternal wisdom of "Lead Us From Darkness To Light" and "Success is achieved through persistent hard work, not merely by wishing", we believe that every child holds infinite potential.
homeContent.principal_message: Dear Parents, Guardians, and Beloved Students, It gives me profound joy to welcome you to Saraswati Vidya Mandir Public School, Semla. Our institution is not merely a place of textbooks and exams; it is a sacred temple of learning where young minds are sculpted with wisdom, character, and self-confidence. With our dedicated faculty, state-of-the-art facilities, and personalized care, we prepare our students to excel in national olympiads, board examinations, and life at large. We welcome you to join our SVMPS family.

facilities.title: Lush Green Campus
facilities.description: Expansive, peaceful, eco-friendly campus with vibrant murals and clean open grounds conducive to focused learning.

facilities.title: Expert Teacher Faculty
facilities.description: Highly qualified, experienced, and compassionate teachers delivering child-centric CBSE curriculum instructions.

facilities.title: Sports & Games Grounds
facilities.description: Dedicated football pitch, cricket nets, volleyball, badminton, and specialized athletic training.

facilities.title: Co-Curricular & Arts
facilities.description: Music, dance, debate, drama, art & craft, and celebration of national and cultural festivals.

facilities.title: Olympiad & Competitive Coaching
facilities.description: Special guidance for International and National Science, Math, and English Olympiads alongside regular studies.

facilities.title: Modern Computer Lab
facilities.description: Hands-on digital education, basic coding, internet research, and multimedia educational tools.

facilities.title: Hostel & Bus Facilities
facilities.description: Safe school bus transport covering Semla, Kathig, Dumka and surrounding villages, plus secure hostel arrangements.

facilities.title: Safe & Inspiring Environment
facilities.description: Secure boundary walls, 24/7 staff supervision, clean purified drinking water, and hygienic facilities.

teachers.name: Sri Ramesh Kumar Mishra
teachers.subject: Science & Physics
teachers.bio: Inspiring young minds with practical science experiments and Olympiad preparation.

teachers.name: Smt. Anita Kumari
teachers.subject: Mathematics
teachers.bio: Specialist in Vedic mathematics tricks and CBSE board examination curriculum.

teachers.name: Sri Rajesh Soren
teachers.subject: English & Social Studies
teachers.bio: Focusing on fluent English communication, grammar foundation, and historical awareness.

teachers.name: Smt. Manisha Murmu
teachers.subject: Hindi & Sanskrit
teachers.bio: Instilling cultural values, Sanskrit shlokas, and literary appreciation in students.

teachers.name: Sri Bikram Kumar Singh
teachers.subject: Computer Science
teachers.bio: Guiding students in digital literacy, computer hardware, and programming fundamentals.

teachers.name: Sri Suresh Mahto
teachers.subject: Physical Education & Games
teachers.bio: Leading cricket coaching, football drills, morning yogasana, and annual sports events.

notices.title: Admissions Open for Academic Session 2026-2027 (Nursery to Class X)
notices.description: Registration and admission forms are now available online and at the school office. Free admission offered as per school notification. Parents are invited to visit the campus at Kathig, Jones, Semla for campus tours and interaction with teachers.

notices.title: National & International Science Olympiad Coaching Schedule
notices.description: Special weekend guidance sessions for registered Olympiad participants will commence every Saturday from 10:00 AM. Study materials and practice tests will be provided by our Science & Math faculty.

notices.title: Annual Sports & Cultural Meet Preparation Notice
notices.description: Trials for football, cricket, track events, and cultural folk dances for the upcoming Annual Function will be conducted next week during sports periods under the supervision of Coach Suresh Mahto.

notices.title: School Bus Route Updates for Kathig & Jones Areas
notices.description: New morning pickup and afternoon drop schedules for the school bus have been updated. All parents utilizing transport facilities are requested to verify timings with the transport coordinator.
